notes.title: Minor updates - Cabling QOL and improved VLAN tag simulation.
notes.content:
0.8.29 - 0.8.33

- new: true reliability now shown even when warranty has not expired.
- new: smoother cables animation.
- new: double click and hold now allows picking multiple cables at once.
- new: added cardboard box for cable carrying/organization.
- new: buying 3 or more cables/peripherals now comes at once in a cardboard box.
- new: VLAN tags now simulated on traversals, access/trunk port implementation.
- new: added a malicious user in lab scenario.
- new: added firewall tutorial.
- new: added What's new panel on main menu.
- new: updated volunteers'/machine-generated translation for Russian, Ukrainian, Chinese and French.

- bugfix: fixed device breaking under warranty.
- bugfix: sftp cp now copies firmware as user-file if not able to install.
- bugfix: fixed problem with empty save files (0 size) causing crash.
- bugfix: fixed device warranty zero-ing during delivery attempt on save reload.
- bugfix: fixed fixed elevator upgrade and DC proposals that should appear on fixed days.
- balance: increased likelihood of elevator upgrades.
- bugfix: fixed surveyor bbcode tags showing on tooltip.
- bugfix: fixed translated text appearing on sticky notes.
- bugfix: fixed dmarket purchased DNS load testers without dnsspam.
- bugfix: fixed VLAN traversals revisiting trunk ports.
- bugfix: fixed sftp copy command showing successful even if firmware not copied.
- bugfix: allow renaming and storage of firmware/programs without installation.
- bugfix: if VLAN firmware is installed together with router firmware, tag stripping no longer applies.
- bugfix: fixed issue with malfunctions with UPS.
- bugfix: fixed restocks when reloading a save.
- bugfix: long texts on dmarket causing horizontal scrolls.
- bugfix: fixed DHCP on-boot text on surveyor.
- bugfix: fixed tagged traffic not being able to revisit managed switch after trunk port.
- bugfix: fixed typo in traffic type (tdp/443).
- bugfix: fixed use stack issues on Helper Central, Data Hub and Full Campus.
- balance: doubled base reliability.
- balance: decentro-wallet now only costs 2 base storage.
- balance: increased HA kernel (high-avail routers spec) from 2/1/(1+1) to 8/2/(3+1) - allow installation of vlan/firewall with rtkernel if jailbroken.
- qol: inputs now freezed during manual save.
- qol: holding a cable now shows its px length.
- qol: hovering over a plugged in cable now shows its px length.
- qol: pressing up/down in multi-line command now moves cursor on commands instead of cycling history.
- ext: unified traversal units to "per tick" on dstat/watch/dmarket and tower link.

notes.title: Devlog #5: Feature Updates for Early Access
notes.content: [p]Hello, tower network admins![/p][p][/p][p]It's been 3 weeks since our EA launch, and we've received tons of useful suggestions from you. Thank you once again for all the support! We're working hard to implement your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to share some new features we've been developing since EA releases. These will be available in the main branch after full beta testing (some features already live):[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Cable QoL Improvement: [/b]cables are automatically sent in a storage box when purchasing 3+[b],[/b] and you can double-click to pick multiple cables at once.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/507ec50f5b7ffd090581e706cbbea46b51d9595f.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Cable Physics Simulation:[/b] Much smoother cable behavior (the old quirky physics is smoother now!)[/p][p][b][u]Before:[/u][/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/29c7cc19532bdd2ddf58cfa00e6e785e2c496f3d.gif"][/img][b][u]After:[/u][/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/d62c459de61da86822eb6e02eca0d71b321d1fea.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Placement Grid System: [/b]Clean socket and rack placement through grid alignment[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/6d930f497a6daa5eea0c129727849b7e985b1969.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Port Highlighting:[/b] Ports now highlight when cables are about to connect.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/101440971f30fd79997f0773a38a29a845ce2fb8.gif"][/img][/p][p]Many bug fixes are also in progress! Check our changelogs for detailed information on all the improvements we're making.[/p][p][/p][p]While other issues may take longer to address, we're committed to improving the game based on your feedback. Keep sharing your honest opinions and suggestions by [b]pressing F8[/b] for quick feedback or [b]joining our Discord[/b] for discussions. [/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Localisation Update:[/b][/u][/p][p]Translation work is ongoing thanks to our volunteer community. If you're interested in helping translate content, join our Discord![/p][p][/p][p][u][i][b]Appreciate if you can record your gameplay to share with us and others![/b][/i][/u][/p][/*][/list]

[h1]New[/h1]
- new: Jailbreak proposal allows forced program installation.
- new: Netwaddr maximum length now configurable, new default at 16 including '@'.

- bugfix: fixed routine not interrupting long-running routines (regression).
- bugfix: fixed router broadcast description wording.
- bugfix: fixed decentro accessible currency sync across co-op clients.
- bugfix: fixed netwaddr reqs in hardmode not required on co-op clients.
- bugfix: fixed lab wall text description.
- bugfix: fixed issue with netaddr deallocation causing netaddr to disappear from auto-complete even if a device with the addr still exists.
- bugfix: fixed DNS load tester not working on saves.
- bugfix: fixed race condition bug on load causing programs to halt on hard mode.
- bugfix: fixed program sync issues on load on co-op clients (including co-op clients not seeing debuggers).

notes.title: Roadmap for Tower Networking Inc.
notes.content:
Hi, Tower Network Admins!

A huge thank you to all of you for your support during our demo! Below is a list of items we plan to work on.

Plan for Early Access in Summer 2025
[list]
[*] endless random floors mode.
[*] secretariat proposals mechanics.
[*] second monitor (unlocked by the second monitor proposal).
[*] power outage random event.
[*] power surge random event.
[*] DMarket discount event.
[*] surge protector device.
[*] simple web browser on MobileOS (for browsing the wiki).
[*] routing information protocol (unlocked by the router configuration proposal).
[*] sftp command (unlocked by the remote backups proposal).
[*] visual network graph app on MobileOS (Autograph).
[*] device warranty mechanics (device can breakdown after warranty expires).
[*] recycling floors.
[*] malicious user behaviors (only visible by packet capture).
[*] cabling toolkit.
[*] crypto mining.
[/list]
Plan for Early Access Q4 2025
[list]
[*] load-balancer and high availability mechanics.
[*] censorship by dns redirection.
[*] tower cctv network.
[*] gameplay mechanics to skip time.
[*] online wiki.
[*] more user types, behaviours and device.
[/list]

Wishlist our game on Steam!

notes.title: Devlog #3: Major Feature Updates from the Last Demo
notes.content:
Greeting, tower network admins!

We’re excited to share some of the latest improvements in the newest demo build!

These changes wouldn’t have been possible without your valuable feedback on our demo. Thanks to your incredible ideas! As always, feel free to let us know what you think.

[b]Some commonly raised issues in the previous demo build:[/b]
[olist]
[*] [b]Difficulty moving between floors using the "Skyline" app.[/b]
Solution: You can now call the elevator from a panel next to it, making floor-to-floor travel more efficient.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/99b997f1da9e3ae0b1f4a8877d0c1aebbe8c7e68.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/f7d52b80997761f1a23f9bbd745e69f605fd8e9d.gif[/img]

Solution: We’ve overhauled Tower Link! Links are now created separately from sockets. Additionally, we’ve added the Socketeer MobileOS app for socket creation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/048e127aac4011735e369a9623ac57ea9cbffa7d.gif[/img]
[/olist]
Work currently in progress:
[list]
[*] Preparing localization placeholder (.po) files for multilingual support.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/fa5deecfe68aabc1342628c31bff9ea705d43a12.png[/img]

Stay tuned, and always share your honest feedback by pressing F8 in-game or joining our Discord!

We are also looking for more volunteers for localization. If you're interested in translating our content, let us know!

notes.title: Demo Changelogs 0.6.0
notes.content:
Hi, tower network admin! We're excited to share a new update based on your valuable feedback on our demo. Here's a summary of the changes in the latest build:

[list]
[*] Demo increased to 10 days.
[*] Floors can now go into a queue that can be approved earlier, and can now spawn at slower rate.
[*] Added Socketeer MobileOS app (to create sockets).
[*] Overhauled Tower Link (Now links are created separately from sockets).
[*] Removed SKYLINE (elevator caller app) in favor of calling elevator from a panel next to it.
[*] MobileOS can now slide to the right (middle mouse click when mouse is inside the MobileOS screen).
[*] ALT key now will background the currently opened MobileOS application (except in netsh).
[*] ALT key now not lower MobileOS when netsh is opened (fixed for German keyboards inputing '@').
[*] Added approximate ruler (activated by holding the 'T' key).
[*] Use MSDF for font anti-aliasing.
[*] Updated fonts for netshell, stickyprints and towerlink.
[*] Updated notification sounds from messages and new secretariat proposals.
[*] CTRL-C no longer quits netsh (use CTRL-D instead).
[*] Cursor interactivity shown (when hovering over something).
[*] Empty netsh command allowed (i.e., hitting enter without commands).
[*] Fix MobileOS not blocking inputs.
[*] Adjusted floor heights to prevent objects falling-off into the void.
[*] Surveyor now also shows lowest satiety along side current satiety.
[*] General optimization on game loading.
[*] Modified tutorial scenarios with new game features & explanation
[/list]
While other issues may take longer to address, we're committed to improving the game based on your feebacks. Feel free to continue sharing your honest opinions and suggestions with us by pressing F8 in demo. 

[i][u][b]Appreciate if you can record your gameplay to share with us and others! [/b][/u][/i]

Thank you.

[b]Hi, tower network admins! [/b]

notes.title: Devlog #2: More Features before the Demo!
notes.content:
[b] Greetings, fellow tower network admins! [/b]

We are thrilled to bring you some new updates as we prepare for the demo release at the end of the year. Thanks for all your excitement and support. Let us dive into the latest features we have added!

[olist]
[*] [b]Improved Command Auto-Completion[/b]: Enjoy a new dropdown feature and the ability to press "Tab" for easy command auto-completion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/9b08f53322aa71762182f7e168eaba4d2847f1d7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/f5a9fc833b65bba8966fb219bbef6f961d47aab8.png[/img]

[*] [b]Rocket Store Go Live[/b]: Rocket Store allows you to purchase a variety of apps that make gameplay both easier and more enjoyable. Here are just a few examples of what you can find in the Rocket Store:

[list]
[*] In-Game Camera: Capture and share screenshots with other players!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/e13e815f9b0a2de2df602b8fd5394f47a6e5c290.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/6dc1fa732ce7f2b3a3cd4ec01bb633cfd0edf36b.gif[/img]
[*] Sticky Notes: Place text labels on devices or stick them to walls so you know what's what.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/d3b1b0e41e3e36fa605fe91558ed85807c5d5bc4.gif[/img]
[/list]
Have some thoughts? Share them with us in the comments. Anyhow, keep your eyes peeled for the upcoming demo release.
[/olist]

notes.title: Playtest Changelogs 0.3.6
notes.content:
Hi playtesters! We're excited to share a new update based on your valuable feedback. Here's a summary of the changes in the latest build:

[list]
[*] Made it easier to unstuck cable that has clipped through the ground.
[*] Added close/history navigation/scroll to top button to wiki.
[*] Fixed scrolling issues when wiki is open (i.e., zooming in on background instead).
[*] Added option to lower/disable RGB shift for accessibility.
[*] Expanded game time ranges (allow slower runs).
[*] Allow Wiki to be used during pause.
[*] KWh ratio now scales with day period.
[*] Added markings to elevator
[*] Added 2000p ethernet cable
[*] Added bandwidth utilization raw number (instead of just percentages).
[*] Prints example netsh commands during help.
[/list]
Your ongoing support is crucial in enhancing the game! We appreciate all your feedback and will focus on implementing suggestions that align with our gameplay vision. Every insight you provide is valuable in shaping our understanding of the player experience.

While some issues may take longer to address, we're committed to improving the game based on your insights. Please continue sharing your thoughts via F8 until the playtest ends on [b]September 30th[/b], 2024. We'll keep refining the demo after this date, using your input to guide future updates.

Thank you for your dedication to improving our game!

notes.title: Playtest Tower Networking Inc. with Us
notes.content:
Hello from Pocosia Studios!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010871/b8139f151919eabc6c244afd96f73b5022904dda.gif[/img]

Thanks for your interest in our game! We are excited to bring you this playtest in September. 

[b]What to Expect:[/b] This playtest is also a candidate for our public demo. It includes a fixed playthrough that acts as a tutorial for the final game. While a playtest was not in our original plans, your enthusiasm has encouraged us to make it happen.

[b]Sign up for Playtest: [/b]Feel free to sign up for the playtest. We will be adding more playtesters in batches as we open up for additional feedback.

[b]Your Feedback: [/b]We are eager to hear your thoughts! Use F8 to share your feedback during gameplay—your input is vital to making the game better. We hope you enjoy the playtest and help us shape the future of our game!

Happy playtesting and don’t forget to wishlist our game if you enjoy the playtest!
